scripts.hello:wt: node scripts/head.mjs wt -w new -d . --title twind-hello powershell -NoLogo -NoExit -Command go run ./examples/hello
scripts.playground:wt: node scripts/head.mjs wt -w new --size 120,34 -d . --title twind-playground --suppressApplicationTitle powershell -NoLogo -NoExit -Command go run ./examples/playground
scripts.docs:wt: node scripts/head.mjs wt -w new --size 120,36 -d . --title twind-docs --suppressApplicationTitle powershell -NoLogo -NoExit -Command go run ./cmd/twind docs
scripts.gallery:wt: node scripts/head.mjs wt -w new --size 110,34 -d . --title twind-gallery --suppressApplicationTitle powershell -NoLogo -NoExit -Command go run ./examples/gallery
scripts.gallery:dark:wt: node scripts/head.mjs wt -w new --size 110,34 -d . --title twind-gallery --suppressApplicationTitle powershell -NoLogo -NoExit -Command go run ./examples/gallery -theme zinc-dark
scripts.sheet: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.local/prints/dev',{recursive:true})" && TWIND_SHEET=$INIT_CWD/.local/prints/dev node scripts/head.mjs go test ./twi/raster/ -run Sheet -count=1
scripts.lint: node scripts/head.mjs go tool golangci-lint run ./...
scripts.check: pnpm vet && pnpm lint && pnpm test
